audit.why: This is a pure hook-accuracy skill matchup, not a battery/sustain lane — content layer already states this at every stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit despite being the numbers field.
audit.why: Rocket Grab (Q) is 20s early down to 16s at rank 5; Power Fist (E) is 7s at rank 1 and opens his combo off an auto-attack reset; Static Field (R) is 60/40/20s and carries a shield that absorbs burst.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers and named the auto-reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 full-layer phases[N].side said Blitzcrank while all 7 content win[N] said Skill — a total disagreement across the whole chart, contradicted further by the packet's own levelChart (all Skill) and the 50.16% win rate.
audit.why: This matchup lives and dies on whether Rocket Grab lands, not on Soraka's healing economy — content's whys already explain this correctly at every stage; the full-layer side column and its whys were simply describing the wrong matchup (a battery-economy narrative that doesn't apply here).
audit.corrected: Flipped all 7 phases[N].side to Skill to match win[N], and rewrote each .why to state the hook-accuracy dynamic instead of the generic battery-economy template.

edits.before: Starcall the contacts — the self-heal funds the bank and the slow annoys their spacing.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: it's all about dodging or body-blocking his hook, not the battery.

edits.before: W opens the battery: your carry's HP bar is now a shared account.
edits.after: Coin-flip: a landed grab kills, a missed one frees you to poke.

edits.before: Equinox threats begin: the silence zone cancels engages mid-cast.
edits.after: Skill-based: hook accuracy against your peel decides it here.

edits.before: Heal the margins and Q the refills — the battery economy runs the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay even — neither side gains a structural edge here.

edits.before: Wish online — every all-in on the map gets a second health bar.
edits.after: At 6, Static Field makes a hook lethal, but the Q must land first.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the silence zones decide dives.
edits.after: First item: his pick threat and your sustain roughly balance out.

edits.before: Late Soraka is the global bank: wish the map, silence the dives, and outlast every ledger.
edits.after: Late, it stays a pure skill matchup decided by positioning and warding, not by healing.

edits.before: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies.
edits.after: Silence (E) shuts down his W-E-R follow-up once a hook lands — it buys the peel window, not free damage.

edits.before: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: Standing in Rocket Grab's line to top off a sliver — one hook and his combo kills through the heal.

edits.before: - Blitzcrank Rocket Grab: matchup-defining — The hook IS the champion — minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. It writes your spacing rules. - E Equinox is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Rocket Grab (Q) is 20s early, 16s at rank 5 — the hook IS the champion, minion cover turns the lane into a farming sim. - Power Fist (E), 7s at rank 1, opens his combo off an auto-reset. - Static Field (R) is 60/40/20s, absorbs your burst.

notes: The whole full-layer chart contradicted the content layer and the packet (7-row inversion) — this is a pure hook-skill matchup, not a battery-economy one, and the fix rewrote every phase why to say so.
